name: Taiwan Fire & Marine Insurance Co., Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Fire & Marine Insurance Co., Ltd. delivers a diverse array of insurance solutions and services throughout Taiwan. Their comprehensive portfolio encompasses standard offerings like fire, marine cargo and hull, fishing vessel, aviation, and automobile coverage. Additionally, they provide policies for money, bond and credit, liability, engineering projects, personal accident, health, and various travel-related protections, including comprehensive travel and travel accident insurance. The company also deals in reinsurance products and specialized coverages such as fine art, burglary, and glass insurance. Established in 1946, the firm's operations are centrally managed from its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.
